script_text: Taurus, this week is going to flip your emotional world upside down — and you'll thank the stars for it. Your ruling planet Venus in your 4th House sextile Neptune early in the week, Monday through Wednesday, brings deep emotional clarity around home and family matters, but Tuesday could surface an unexpected conversation that demands patience. Mercury forms a powerful trine to Pluto mid-week on Wednesday, triggering your 7th House of partnerships, which is a turning point for love, specifically redefining a relationship boundary. By Thursday, Jupiter enters a favorable angle with your 10th House of career, Taurus, meaning money opportunities land directly in your lap over the weekend. Thursday and Sunday are your power days because Venus trigns your solar 10th House boosting professional visibility. Wednesday is also strong, but watch for heated exchanges in the evening when Mars squares Mercury. Saturday is your worst day because the Moon in your 2nd House opposes Saturn, bringing financial delays. Let your grounded, earth-sign energy guide every decision, and say yes only when it serves your long-term security. Drop your experiences in the comments.
